note: Which projects report floor areas under URA's harmonised definitions (circular URA/PB/2022/09-DCG): applies to development applications submitted on/after 1 Jun 2023 and to GLS sites launched for sale on/after 1 Sep 2022. URA's transaction data carries no flag, so this file is the source of truth: 'confirmed' entries are sourced; the rule marks others as 'likely'; the force_* lists override both. Edit freely.

rule.description: Leasehold project whose lease commenced in 2023 or later AND whose first new sale is in March 2024 or later (Lentor Mansion, the first harmonised launch).
